summary: Move the learning-map framework behind a Settings switch “打开学习图模式（beta）” (default off). Off: recommendations are hotspot mode (profile + sparse ranking, last 30 days, new-paper weight 0.5 unless the owner chose otherwise) and every learning-map entry point is hidden; the stored maps and progress are kept; on restores them.
scope_note: Worktree route-beta-switch from main 0c288b3. Independent of the UI restyle unit on branch ui-elavatine (both touch app/static/settings.html and i18n; expect a textual merge of those files). No .app build by design.

budget_impact.rationale: A local setting and local ranking defaults. No model call, provider, cap, retry or outbound field changes. The public-metadata candidate refresh uses a 30-day from_date by default in hotspot mode instead of five years; this narrows, not widens, what is requested.
budget_impact.before: Route mode available whenever a project had a map; plain ranking with no recency default.
budget_impact.after: Route mode only with the beta switch on; hotspot mode by default with a 30-day window and 0.5 new-paper weight unless the owner chose values. Daily core model minimum remains 0 tokens.
budget_impact.developer_usage: none: no model call was made for this unit

open_risks: The 30-day window and 0.5 weight are defaults chosen with the owner, not validated for recommendation quality.
Library graph view and weekly report were not seen with real content in a browser.
A page that is already open keeps its old state until reloaded.
No independent review yet (class critical by path rule); required before release.
No native window check and no release build.
